- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Veda has significantly influenced yoga, meditation, Ayurveda, and Buddhism.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Veda is considered the foundational text of yoga, with references in the Yoga Sutras.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Veda contains meditative practices like mantra repetition (japa), contemplation (dhyana), and mindfulness (smriti).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ayurveda is rooted in the Vedic tradition, with concepts based on the Veda.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Buddhism was influenced by the Veda, with similarities in concepts like the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path.
